summary: Prepared composite source retains canonical supplier /4 admission plus export at one existing key with independent outer CAS cursors. Pending/held history can be inspected as inert data; explicit checked abandonment and quarantine preserve envelope/export and sticky failure/conflict data without authenticated readiness. Positive lifecycle gates are derived only from freshly checked supplier events, never deserialized cached Known observations; nested export allocation/root checks run before temporary effects. The upper FsQuint driver captures real atomic attach, separate pending/accepted writes, a post-replacement failure, cold read and consumed-challenge/missing-termination/stale-cursor refusals. Its source observation model compares actual cursors, complete original/configuration retention, challenge consumption, reader-intent absence, first failure, lock release, single key, readback and successful real cleanup. The separate future-boundary model is not implementation coverage; committed reply loss preserves settled state. Genuine signed writer-termination input for positive reader consumption remains missing. Source inspection/replay supplies no production grant, ACK, host reservation, deletion, native namespace/root/clock custody, reader settlement or receiving ABI. AllocationReceiptDigest still has no declared production recipe; explicit test binding/configuration establishes no receipt interoperability or native-policy authentication. These citations describe prepared source; independent review, normal delivery and native/consumer acceptance remain separate.
title: Checked original-source recovery and actual upper replay remain inert
